subject: Sparrow Labs — Accelerator promo credits & milestone gating
messages:
From: Ava Lang <ava@sparrowlabs.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: promo allocation for LumenAI (accelerator demo cohort)

Hi Marissa —

Quick note from Sparrow: our Q1 demo cohort includes LumenAI (seed, ML infra heavy). They've asked if Redwood can provide a conditional promo allocation (60k tokens + 25k embeddings) and a single-week trial extension for their integration testing ahead of demo day.

They've used Redwood in a pilot last month and the engineering lead reports good perf; the ask is promotional (not contractual) but they want the credits committed in writing to include milestone gating (demo-ready integration by 1/20).

Would Redwood be open to this kind of conditional promo? If yes, please advise what approvals we need and what usage caps/policy language you'd like surfaced.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min sync.

— Ava
Director, Partnerships, Sparrow Labs
[Attachment: Sparrow_Program_OnePager.pdf (PDF, 52KB)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Ava Lang <ava@sparrowlabs.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: promo allocation for LumenAI (accelerator demo cohort)

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the note and the one-pager. We like supporting demo cohorts. High-level: we can usually approve promotional allocations up to a $3k equivalent for cohort members via the partner program; anything above that requires a credit-exception and milestone gating approved by Sales Ops and Finance.

Two quick asks so we can move fast:
- Can Sparrow confirm the target usage profile (est. tokens / embeddings week-over-week)?
- Do you need the trial extension to be a true extension of the free trial period, or can we provide a limited promo pool tied to the account?

Looping in Karthik from Sales to surface an approval path and Monica from CS to help with onboarding/guardrails. Please send the SOW or milestone checklist if you have it.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
[Office: +1 415-555-0192]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: internal: Sparrow promo request — proposed exception path

Marissa / Monica —

Saw Ava's request. Proposed approach:
1) Approve a conditional promotional pool: 60k tokens + 25k embeddings for LumenAI (non-transferable).
2) Milestone gating (Sparrow confirms integration + demo artifacts): Release half of promo on account activation; remaining half after demo readiness sign-off (target 2028-01-20).
3) Require SOC2 summary + basic AUP acceptance. Sparrow to attach SOW and PO or DocuSign.
4) Finance/Legal approval required for anything > $3k equivalent. Markus — can you confirm whether we can sign an internal promo agreement or do we need a one-off CRO sign-off?

Monica — CS to own onboarding checklist and ensure usage caps and alerting are in place.

Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: internal: Sparrow promo request — proposed exception path

Karthik —

We can approve a one-off promotional allocation with a short waiver form signed by Sparrow and the startup (LumenAI). No CRO signature required for this value band if we record the SOW and have PO/DocuSign on file. Key points for legal:
- Non-transferable clause and explicit milestone gating with deliverables.
- Expiration window (we prefer 45 days) and a usage cap enforcement mechanism.
- SOC2 summary is fine; if they plan to upload customer data we need SOC2 Type II or equivalent — but for this demo use it should be fine with the summary and AUP.

I'll draft a short promo waiver template and share.

— Markus
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Ava Lang <ava@sparrowlabs.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding & caps — LumenAI (Sparrow cohort)

Hi Ava / Marissa —

Thanks — Monica here from Customer Success. To make the trial extension low-risk and fast:
- We'll provision a fixed promo pool (60k tokens / 25k embeddings) scoped to the LumenAI production-sandbox account.
- Auto-cutoff once the pool is consumed; no overage allowed. We will enable alerts at 50% and 90%.
- Onboarding checklist (to be completed by LumenAI engineering lead): basic integration test, 1 sample prompt set, and a short demo recording.

Ava — can you provide the LumenAI contact and confirm the demo date target? Also attaching a blank onboarding checklist for review.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
[Attachment: onboarding_checklist_template.docx (DOCX, 24KB)]

Ava

Subject: Promo allocation approved (Sparrow / LumenAI) — next steps

Hi Ava / Priya —

Good news: Promo allocation approved under waiver. Summary of agreement below (please confirm by EOD Tuesday):

- Promo pool: 60,000 generation tokens + 25,000 embeddings, non-transferable
- Delivery: 30k tokens + 12.5k embeddings on activation (account provisioned & onboarding checklist accepted); remainder released after demo-ready sign-off by Sparrow (target demo date 2028-01-18; release window up to 2028-01-25)
- Expiration: unused promo expires 45 days after activation
- Security: SOC2 summary received; production data uploads require Type II (not expected for demo)
- Controls: Auto-cutoff on pool exhaustion; alerts at 50/90%; no overages permitted
- Documentation: Sparrow to provide signed SOW or DocuSign (preferable). Redwood to send promo waiver for signature.

Attachments included in Sparrow's email will be saved on the deal folder. Karthik / Markus / Monica: please proceed to circulate the waiver & DocuSign link; Monica will provision the promo pool after signed waiver and onboarding checklist are complete.

Marissa
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
